title: Turn system-improvement kickoff into implementation plan
description: Use the durable kickoff note and book-derived system lessons to produce an implementation-ready plan for the recent MAP system-improvement work. The plan should separate high-priority workstreams from backlog items, name concrete next actions, and preserve the design spine that MAP is a coordination system with AI workers.
acceptance_criteria: The plan note lists the current workstreams in priority order and explains why that order is chosen.
Each priority workstream is translated into concrete implementation actions with observable outputs or file targets.
The note links back to MAP_System/notes/system-improvement-kickoff.md and MAP_System/notes/book-lessons-agent-system.md so Claude can resume from durable context.
